messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Hello ApnaBank support, main khud call kar raha hoon apne login issue ke liye. Ticket #55231.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Ji sir, aap ne jo password reset request ki hai us ke liye ek OTP generate hua hai.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Haan wohi request ki thi mujhe. Code aa gaya hai 99213 — use this code to log in to your own account wala process batayein ab.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Sir code aap khud app mein enter karein, hum kabhi OTP nahi maangte. Bas confirm kar dein reset ho gaya?

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Ho gaya, login ho gaya. Shukriya, great service!
